text: Seven years into the zombie apocalypse, a handful of scientists and soldiers live in [an underground missile bunker in the Florida Everglades|trigger|cut off and trapped], vastly outnumbered by [the undead hordes|threat|the dead that rise] above. Dr. Sarah Bowman searches for a cure, while Dr. Logan, whom the soldiers call Frankenstein, keeps captive zombies in [an underground corral|images|ropes, cages and executions] and [tries to condition them into docility|wrong|meddling with life itself]. As supplies dwindle, the unstable Captain Rhodes declares martial law and threatens to execute anyone who interferes.
